stop_reason: No rights-cleared photo of the co-axial watch. Checked Wikimedia Commons (Daniels: only a Grand Complication pocket watch, CC BY-SA 4.0; Omega Co-Axial: nothing), the library (no Co-Axial match), and a press-image search (none found). The Science Museum 'Millenium' photo is CC BY-NC-SA, so it is not usable for a commercial account. Story beats need rights-cleared images, so the post cannot be built to the recipe. Facts checked so far: Omega's chronicle says the Co-Axial escapement was released on 12 April 1999 and calls it the first practical new escapement in some 250 years. Accounts differ on whether Omega bought the rights or co-developed it with Daniels, so that claim needs a second source before use. Next step: find a licensed photo of a Co-Axial Omega (or Daniels' watch with a Co-Axial movement) or an Omega press photo, then retry.
